eval.description: Dyno Therapeutics held-out eval of predicting AAV capsid packaging from sequence. Labs give models unpublished or held-out capsid variants (often with optional protein-language-model or corpus tools) and score ranking or discrimination against wet-lab packaging labels. OpenAI cards report Spearman correlation; Anthropic cards report AUROC under several resource conditions. Samples are not public.
eval.summary: Measures how well the model predicts which AAV capsid variants will package successfully from their protein sequences.

links.title: GPT-5.6 system card (AAV Capsid Packaging Prediction)

versions.changes: Dyno-curated unpublished packaging labels; OpenAI and Anthropic harnesses differ (Spearman on continuous scores vs AUROC on binary labels).

scores.description: How well predicted packaging ranks or separates true packaging outcomes (Spearman or AUROC, depending on the lab harness).

metrics.description: Spearman rank correlation of predicted vs measured packaging (OpenAI cards; ESM-2 baseline also reported).
AUROC against binary packaging labels under Anthropic resource conditions (no corpus, ESM-2, public corpora).
